data: I have fixed the configuration resolution precedence issue in config/merge.go. The problem was that the Resolve function was applying overrides first, then file values, then defaults - which reversed the intended precedence order. I corrected the order to apply defaults first, then file values, then overrides, so that explicit runtime overrides correctly win over file values, which win over defaults.
